g.text: Physical Database Architecture | Schema: SalesForce | RDBMS: MySQL 8.0+ (InnoDB) | Crow's Foot Notation
ℹ Cascades deletion to marks, complaints, and parent calls
ℹ Graded in marks; optionally referenced in complaints
ℹ UQ(student_id, subject_id) | Failed when marks < 33
ℹ Student ticket tracking with optional subject link
ℹ Enforces 1:1 call per failed mark to avoid duplicate calls
1. Academic Marks & Twilio Parent Call Workflow
• Pass Rule: Marks are scored on a scale of 0 to 100. Any mark < 33.00 is marked FAILED.
• Single Call Guarantee: Both parent_calls and scheduled_parent_calls use mark_id as Primary Key,
guaranteeing that a failed subject mark can never spawn duplicate voice call records.
• Pass Resolution: If a mark is updated to ≥ 33, any active call record is automatically purged.
• Polling Interval: Runs every 15 seconds inside the Tomcat application lifecycle.
for sub-millisecond lookups of due records where scheduled_at_epoch_ms <= now().
• Timezone: User interface operates in Indian Standard Time (Asia/Kolkata, UTC+05:30).
• ON DELETE CASCADE: Deleting a student in student_details automatically removes their
student_marks, complaints, parent_calls, and scheduled_parent_calls safely.
• ON DELETE SET NULL: Deleting a subject resets complaints.subject_id to NULL without
deleting the student's complaint ticket history.
• PBKDF2 Hashing: Passwords stored as pbkdf2$iterations$salt$hash; no plaintext.
• First Login Enforced: must_change_password flag forces immediate credential update.
• Phone Validation: parent_mobile validated against E.164 regular expression format.
🛡 Production Ready: Fully normalized relational design compliant with 3NF standards.
